cards.heading: What does it look like to move in step with God, not rushing ahead or falling behind?
cards.quote: Jenessa Wait is a trusted guide to help you discern God's timing and move forward in confidence through every door He opens.
cards.name: Rebekah Lyons
cards.role: Bestselling Author, Speaker, and Co-Founder of Thinq Media

cards.heading: Moving with God is not just a message Jenessa Wait teaches; it is a life she has faithfully lived.
cards.quote: Walking through surrender, stewardship, service, and bold obedience to God's promises. With clarity and conviction, she offers nine practical and spiritual keys that help readers move from stagnation to possession of what God has spoken. This book will strengthen your faith, challenge unbelief, and anchor you in the house of God as you step courageously into His promises for your life.
cards.name: Joaquin and Renée Evans

cards.heading: Jenessa Wait is someone whose life speaks just as powerfully as her words.
cards.quote: What has always stood out to me is her persistent teachability. She honors the voices God has placed in her life and leans in to discern what He is saying and where He is leading. In Moving with God, she brings that same grace to the reader, helping you see the Father's heart even in hidden or stretching seasons. With clarity and Spirit-led insight, she offers a practical pathway for partnering with God and stepping into His promises. This book will steady your heart, awaken fresh courage, and remind you that you are not forgotten. God is actively leading you forward right now.
cards.name: Bethany Hicks
cards.role: Co-Founder of Prophetic Company & Author of The God Connection

cards.heading: Jenessa Wait's honest and vulnerable storytelling dismantles the addiction to hustle and calls us back to belief.
cards.quote: From the very first page, Jenessa Wait beckons us into a deeper life of faith, trust, and vision. Moving with God serves as both an invitation and a guide into the life we ache for but often struggle to access. This book encourages readers to dream, take risks, and recognize God's presence. It challenges the status quo and invites us into a life marked by surrender and expectancy, emphasizing humility, trust, and laying everything down to truly find life.
cards.name: Jessi Green
cards.role: Author of The Invitation & Wildfires, Co-Lead Pastor of Salt Church

about.body1: Jenessa Wait is a wife, mother, creator, and speaker passionate about helping women step boldly into the promises of God. She runs a successful online business selling faith-filled goods around the world. Through her books and products, she reaches countless women with messages of truth, hope, and faith. Jenessa and her husband Ben serve on the leadership team at Bethel Austin. Jenessa and Ben have three children and live in Austin, Texas.
about.pull: After walking through seasons of waiting, unanswered prayers, and unexpected detours, she discovered that God's plan isn't simply to wait on Him—but to learn how to move with Him.
about.body2: That journey became the foundation for her first book, Moving with God, a practical and hope-filled guide for anyone longing to step into the promises God has for them.
